notes: Tab switching blocked during proxy check: — the `checkProxies` thunk was `await`-ing the entire batch check IPC call, keeping the thunk pending until all proxies were checked. Changed to fire-and-forget: the check starts immediately and the thunk resolves right away. Tab navigation is now responsive during checks. Check lifecycle (`started`/`progress`/`complete`) continues to be handled by IPC events. | Discovery Engine search input lacks focus indicator: — added `autoFocus`, a `useRef` with `useEffect` focus, and a blinking cursor cue so the input is immediately ready for typing when the panel opens. | Proxy Chains rename input focus: — added `useRef` fallback to ensure the text input gains focus when rename mode is activated.
